name: ChatRelay for WooCommerce
author: athingeo

sections.description:
ChatRelay for WooCommerce adds an intuitive, high-converting direct ordering button onto your WooCommerce single product pages.

Shoppers click the button and are instantly directed to chat with a personalized, pre-filled message containing the exact product title, price, and store URL.

Why Store Owners Love It

  • Instant Conversions: Ideal for customers who prefer chatting or asking quick questions before committing to credit card checkouts.
  • 100% Lightweight: Clean code, no external JavaScript bloat, zero impact on Google PageSpeed or Core Web Vitals.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce custom order tables.
  • Customizable Message Template: Tailor the greeting with dynamic short-tags ({product_title}, {product_price}, {product_url}).

Pro Features

Looking for high-volume sales features? Check out our Pro edition:
* Multi-Agent & Multi-Department Routing (Sales, Support, Billing).
* Variable Product support (passes selected color, size, and variations into chat).
* Automated WooCommerce Draft Order creation.
* Meta Pixel and Google Analytics 4 click tracking events.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire chatrelay-for-woocommerce directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ folder.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ‘WooCommerce > Chat Order’ in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your chat phone number with international country code.
  5. Click ‘Save Changes’. Your button is now live!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

The free version links directly to the product page. The Pro edition dynamically listens to attribute switches (such as Size and Color) and appends chosen variations to the text message.

Will this slow down my website?

Not at all. The plugin renders pure HTML and utilizes native WooCommerce template hooks with zero heavy JavaScript libraries.
